decks.notes: The deck relies on controlling the game by using cards like Force of Will, Stifle, and Swords to Plowshares to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect its own key cards like Murktide Regent and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd. Brainstorm and Ponder help the player dig for important cards, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage. The deck also has access to powerful planeswalkers like Quantum Riddler to further control the board. The mana base includes fetchlands and dual lands to ensure consistent color access and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The main concept of this deck is to use the Aluren combo to cheat Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Acererak the Archlich into play, generating powerful synergy and card advantage. By utilizing cards like Show and Tell and Stock Up, the deck can quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and spells. The inclusion of disruptive elements like Force of Will and Veil of Summer help protect the combo and ensure its success. With careful planning and strategic play, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver opponents in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize aggressive Eldrazi creatures, supported by mana acceleration and disruption cards, to quickly overwhelm the opponent and disrupt their game plan. By utilizing cards like Eldrazi Temple and Eye of Ugin to cheat out powerful creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Reality Smasher early in the game, the deck can put pressure on the opponent from the get-go. Cards like Chalice of the Void and Thorn of Amethyst help disrupt the opponent's spells, while Wasteland and Glaring Fleshraker can disrupt their mana base. With a focus on quick and overwhelming aggression, this Eldrazi Aggro deck aims to close out games swiftly.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing counter spells, removal spells, and disruptive tactics like Wasteland and Stifle. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage through cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Quantum Riddler. It also includes powerful finishers like Murktide Regent and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd to close out the game once control has been established. The deck's mana base is optimized to support its spells and ensure consistency in its control strategy.

A deck that focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient creatures and removal spells. The strategy is to control the board with cheap removal and counter spells, while deploying threats that can quickly close out the game. The deck aims to maintain tempo by efficiently using its resources and disrupting the opponent's plays to gain a strategic advantage. It combines disruptive elements with aggressive creatures to create a fast-paced and interactive gameplay experience.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while quickly establishing a board presence through efficient creatures and disruptive spells. The key strategy involves using counterspells and removal spells to control the opponent's threats and then using powerful creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Nethergoyf to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and resilience, while cards like Thoughtseize and Mishra's Bauble help to disrupt the opponent's hand and strategy. The deck has a strong tempo aspect, aiming to stay ahead on board and in card advantage throughout the game.

The main idea of this Legacy Control-Lands deck is to disrupt opponent's resources and control the game through land interactions. By utilizing cards like Thespian's Stage, Crop Rotation, and Exploration, the deck can quickly assemble powerful land combos such as Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 indestructible token. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Wasteland and Pithing Needle to hamper opponent's strategies. Overall, the deck focuses on strategic land plays to control the game and outmaneuver opponents.

The key concept of this deck is to assemble the necessary pieces to combo off and win the game quickly. The deck utilizes cards like Burning Wish, Gamble, Lion's Eye Diamond, and Dark Ritual to generate mana and find key combo pieces such as The Fantasticar, Song of Creation, and Tendrils of Agony. By using explosive mana generation and card draw from cards like Lotus Petal and Echo of Eons, the deck aims to set up a powerful turn where multiple spells are cast in succession to overwhelm the opponent and secure the win.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponents' strategies by utilizing land destruction and lock-down effects. It seeks to control the game by utilizing cards like Wasteland, Sphere of Resistance, and Crop Rotation to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The deck also includes the combo of Thespian's Stage and Dark Depths to create a powerful 20/20 Marit Lage token. With a mix of utility lands, control elements, and powerful combos, this deck aims to grind out victories by resource denial and overwhelming opponents with a powerful land-based strategy.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature play and disruption through hand control and removal spells. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Swords to Plowshares, Cabal Therapy, and Wasteland, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and clear the way for its creatures to deal damage. In addition, cards like Goblin Bombardment, Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, and Amped Raptor provide additional damage and value to maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes utility lands like Karakas and Plateau to provide flexibility and further disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using counterspells like Force of Will and Daze, while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Murktide Regent. The deck also focuses on card advantage and selection with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder, allowing the player to efficiently control the game tempo. The inclusion of removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize allows the deck to handle threats from the opponent while maintaining its aggressive strategy. Overall, the deck aims to control the game while rapidly advancing its own win conditions.

The deck focuses on using Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer to recur artifacts from the graveyard, especially Urza's Saga and Mishra's Bauble, to generate card advantage and create a powerful board state. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Aphetto Alchemist are used to further manipulate artifacts. The key strategy is to assemble a combo involving artifacts like Phyrexian Dragon Engine, Legion Extruder, and Agatha's Soul Cauldron to outvalue and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Force of Will and additional win conditions with cards like Loki, God of Mischief.

The focus of this deck is on aggressive gameplay, utilizing efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride to quickly pressure the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Static Prison to control the board and slow down the opponent's game plan. With powerful cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Goblin Bombardment, the deck aims to close out the game swiftly once it gains an advantage. By combining efficient creatures with disruptive elements, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through quick and relentless aggression.

The deck focuses on using graveyard and sacrifice synergies to quickly ramp up mana and field presence to overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Wight of the Reliquary and Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis, along with support from Sylvan Safekeeper and Elvish Reclaimer for protection and searching capabilities. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the opponent's board state. The key strategy is to aggressively build up resources while disrupting the opponent's game plan, ultimately leading to a powerful combo finish.

This Dimir Tempo deck focus on disrupting the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient creatures and removal spells. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while deploying threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Barrowgoyf to close out the game quickly. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Brainstorm to maintain consistency and control the pace of the game. With a strong balance of disruption and aggression, this deck aims to control the tempo of the game and secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand, Atraxa, and Koma, then utilizing reanimation spells like Animate Dead, Reanimate, and Goryo's Vengeance to bring them back onto the battlefield. The use of cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal allow for explosive starts, while cards like Unmask and Cabal Therapy disrupt the opponent's game plan. With the ability to quickly bring back massive threats, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through powerful combo plays.
